inputs_rule: race card (recent runs, declared body weight, horse_no), market order and JMA wind come only from the signed request snapshot frozen at or before prediction_cutoff; otherwise the arm does not fire
evidence_rule: same as the extended profile. Known-result replay over settled races is context only (参考値, computed after the results were known).
budget_note: arms rebuild tickets with Production MEC, so investment differs; report PFS, PFS excl. max payout, net profit change and investment change together.

arms.rule: today <= 1400m, last run >= 1600m, no recent run <= 1400m, last-run best corner position <= 50% of field -> add to P3 under every pair
arms.metric: net profit change vs frozen Production tickets; must beat P3_SHORTEN_SAME_COUNT_CONTROL
arms.promote_if: at 100 firing races beats Production and the control on net profit and PFS excl. max payout -> Owner decision
arms.reject_if: at 50 firing races not better than the control

arms.rule: in the same firing races add the same number of P3 runners by pre-cutoff market order (Static rank if no market)
dirt today, all recent runs on turf, declared body weight >= 460kg, horse_no > field/2, some recent first-corner position <= 40% of field -> add to P3
arms.metric: net profit change; must beat P3_FIRST_DIRT_SAME_COUNT_CONTROL
arms.promote_if: at 100 firing races beats Production and the control -> Owner decision
arms.reject_if: at 50 firing races not better than the control

arms.rule: same races, same count, by market order
pre-cutoff JMA wind_speed_ms >= 8.0 -> add pre-cutoff market top-3 missing from W as PROTECTED heads
arms.metric: net profit change; must beat W_WIND8_STATIC_SAME_COUNT_CONTROL
arms.promote_if: at 30 firing races beats Production and the control -> Owner decision (rare condition: about 1% of races)
arms.reject_if: at 30 firing races not better than the control

arms.rule: same windy races, add the same number of heads by Static rank
